caption:
Yes, it really is that deep.

No filters, no tricks. This is what a normal storm day looks like in the forests around Kamifurano. Some days you can't see your own skis. You just trust the turn and come up laughing.

We have a handful of places left for next winter. Send us a message and tell us which month you're thinking of.
